newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FINANCE MINISTER TOPS EUROMONEY POLL - FINMIN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FINANCE MINISTER TOPS EUROMONEY POLL - FINMIN.

text.p: Poland's Grzegorz Kolodko was named the finance minister of the year in Eastern and Central Europe the annual survey by Euromoney magazine, the Polish finance ministry's press office said on Wednesday.

It said in a statement that Kolodko had won the poll for bringing Poland into the Organisation of the Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) earlier this year and for successful pro-growth and anti-inflationary policies.
The official awarding ceremony will take place in Washington on Monday, it added.
Euromoney selects best and worst finance ministers each year based on their records as well as views from the markets.

The finance ministry's statement did not say whom the monthly financial magazine named the worst minister. In 1995, it selected Philippines' Roberto de Ocampo as the best minister and Japan's Japan's Masayoshi Takemura as the world's worst.

Kolodko, an independent technocrat, has often been in conflict over his strict financial policy with the two ruling leftist parties -- the ex-communist Democratic Left Alliance (SLD) and the Polish Peasant Party (PSL).
